mapper.select: SELECT lo.id AS learning_outcome_id, lo.code AS learning_outcome_code, lo.description AS learning_outcome_description, glo.id AS group_learning_outcome_id, glo.name AS group_learning_outcome_name, glo.description AS group_learning_outcome_description FROM quiz_learning_outcomes qlo JOIN learning_outcomes lo ON lo.id = qlo.learning_outcome_id LEFT JOIN group_learning_outcomes glo ON glo.id = lo.group_learning_outcome_id WHERE qlo.quiz_id = #{quizId} AND lo.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY glo.name NULLS FIRST, lo.code
